mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_participants ( id, task_id, vm_id, role, status, data_source, current_epoch, loss, accuracy, last_heartbeat, final_accuracy, final_loss, training_time, data_size, participant_id, data_ratio, capabilities, max_cpu_usage, max_memory_usage, created_at, updated_at, joined_at, left_at, parameters ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{vmId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{dataSource}, #{currentEpoch}, #{loss}, #{accuracy}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{finalAccuracy}, #{finalLoss}, #{trainingTime}, #{dataSize}, #{participantId}, #{dataRatio}, #{capabilities}, #{maxCpuUsage}, #{maxMemoryUsage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{joinedAt}, #{leftAt}, #{parameters} )
mapper.update: UPDATE task_participants SET role = #{role}, status = #{status}, data_source = #{dataSource}, current_epoch = #{currentEpoch}, loss = #{loss}, accuracy = #{accuracy}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, final_accuracy = #{finalAccuracy}, final_loss = #{finalLoss}, training_time = #{trainingTime}, data_size = #{dataSize}, participant_id = #{participantId}, data_ratio = #{dataRatio}, capabilities = #{capabilities}, max_cpu_usage = #{maxCpuUsage}, max_memory_usage = #{maxMemoryUsage}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, joined_at = #{joinedAt}, left_at = #{leftAt}, parameters = #{parameters} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task_participants SET status = #{status}, current_epoch = #{currentEpoch}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND vm_id = #{vmId}

UPDATE task_participants SET status = #{status}, current_epoch = #{currentEpoch}, accuracy = #{accuracy}, loss = #{loss}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND vm_id = #{vmId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(vm_id, 'UNKNOWN') as vm_id, COALESCE(current_epoch, 0) as current_epoch, COALESCE(status, 'UNKNOWN') as status, COALESCE(last_heartbeat, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') as last_heartbeat, COALESCE(updated_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') as updated_at, COALESCE(id, 'UNKNOWN') as participant_id FROM task_participants WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND id IS NOT NULL -- 确保主键存在 AND vm_id IS NOT NULL AND status IS NOT NULL AND current_epoch IS NOT NULL -- 确保轮次字段存在 AND LENGTH(TRIM(vm_id)) > 0 -- 确保vm_id不是空字符串 AND LENGTH(TRIM(status)) > 0 -- 确保status不是空字符串 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM task_participants WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM task_participants WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND (current_epoch != #{currentEpoch} OR status != 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE task_participants SET status = 'TRAINING', current_epoch = #{newEpoch}, loss = NULL, accuracy = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(current_epoch) as latest_round FROM task_participants WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND current_epoch IS NOT NULL
